title: Aldrovandi Digital Twin
description: A digital reconstruction of the exhibition The Other Renaissance: Ulisse Aldrovandi and the Wonders of the World, connecting 3D heritage assets, Linked Open Data, and interactive narrative visualisation for web and VR.
role: Worked on the Aldrovandi Digital Twin within the CHANGES project (NextGenerationEU, PE 0000020), contributing across semantic data modelling, software development, and the integration of 3D assets with Linked Open Data and narrative visualisation services. I contributed to metadata collection and early semantic modelling, then developed the MELODY API to dynamically integrate semantic data, visualisations, and contextual narratives into the ATON web and VR environments. I also developed the companion web catalogue for browsing and exploring the digitised objects outside the immersive experience. This work involved close collaboration with cultural heritage scholars, 3D specialists, data modellers, and developers, and contributed to a reusable workflow for 3D cultural heritage publication.

title: MELODY — Make mE a Linked Open Data storY
description: An extensible, reusable web platform for retrieving, presenting, and publishing Linked Data as interactive Data Stories, used in graduate courses and ongoing research.
role: Lead Full-stack Developer on MELODY (Polifonia, H2020, G.A. 101004746), originally developed from my master’s thesis and subsequently expanded within the Polifonia project. I lead the full software lifecycle, from prototyping and architectural design to full-stack development, deployment, documentation, and maintenance of live instances. I developed the reusable components for SPARQL querying, data aggregation, visualisation, HTML rendering, and narrative composition that underpin the platform’s storytelling workflow.

title: Polifonia Web Portal
description: A web application for serendipitous exploration of musical heritage data from the Polifonia project, integrating nine heterogeneous knowledge graphs through fast text-search indexing and a unified REST API.
role: Backend & Data Engineer on the Polifonia Web Portal (Polifonia, H2020, G.A. 101004746). Built the Flask backend and REST APIs supporting a React frontend, implemented reconciliation workflows to align entities across nine heterogeneous knowledge graphs, and integrated Sonic indexing to support rapid search and exploratory access.

title: The Journey of Art
description: A digital storytelling project tracing how a work of art moves before arriving at its current location, built on Linked Open Data from the Zeri Photographic Archive.
role: Queried and transformed Linked Open Data from the Zeri Photographic Archive, prepared the resulting datasets in Python, and developed the interactive visualisations used to communicate the movement and provenance of artworks.

title: Cool — COntent mOduLe
description: A knowledge representation spin-off of the ArCo network, defining an ontology module to represent and provide structured knowledge about a specific class of cultural assets.
role: Defined competency questions, contributed to the conceptual modelling process, and formalised the resulting ontology module in OWL using Protégé.

title: WoodsLOD
description: A Linked Open Data project modelling the relationships between heterogeneous cultural and historical entities connected to a shared event, using established cultural heritage and temporal ontologies.
role: Modelled and published the dataset as Linked Open Data, applying the CIDOC-CRM and CCO standards together with the OWL-Time ontology to represent temporal relationships between entities.

title: Ragù
description: A digital archive collecting, cataloguing, and making accessible a little-explored part of Italian culinary heritage: handwritten family cookbooks.
role: Managed the project’s data workflow, including  cleaning, validation, and automated catalogue updates through Python scripts and GitHub Actions.
